missing_evidence.detail: The thread receipt amount is unknown. Excluded from totals, not treated as zero. Known-amount take home and hourly rate may overstate earnings after this expense is recovered.

Original receipt/order images and the original statement file are outside the permitted inputs. Statuses are audited against supplied transaction fields, notes, messages and bank_lines, not independently against those original files. File existence and legibility are not verified.

The original mismatched document amount is available only in transaction notes. The bank amount is independently checked against bank_lines. Whether the difference is underpayment or another error remains unresolved.

Intake timestamps and nightly reconciliation state are absent. This audit reconstructs end-of-week decision evidence, not an observed execution history. Missing amount supports an intake flag; the noted amount discrepancy supports a later reference-match flag.

Draft recommendations and an actual Auditor ruling are not permitted inputs. Only the evidence-supported direction of a ruling is derived; no projected raise is asserted. Day Zero volume and projection rules remain unconfirmed in SYSTEM_DESIGN.md:375-382.

auditor_direction.direction: Favor improving hourly earnings and fixing loss-making keychain pricing/costs before growing their current sales mix; do not endorse volume growth on bestseller status alone. Bracelets have positive direct profit and higher direct profit per hour. Shared time remains unallocated.
auditor_direction.limitation: This is an evidence-supported direction, not a verified existing ruling or a forecast. Actual gains need demand, feasibility and approved projection rules.

audit.conclusion: Arithmetic and supplied-row evidence agree, with no unresolved specification conflict; this does not clear review items or replace original-document verification.
